problem_statement:
Hide app banners from within the mobile apps
#### Steps to reproduce
1. Use the mobile app and navigate to "My Sites"
2. Select a site and scroll down to "View My Site"
3. Select "My Site" from the masterbar and navigate to Stats
4. See the app banner at the bottom

#### What I expected
My website without an app banner

#### What happened instead
The app banner is shown

#### Browser / OS version
WordPress iOS and Android app

#### Screenshot / Video
![img_7491](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1158819/53675164-b3997000-3c48-11e9-855b-cac84489e8bd.png)



#### Context / Source

We are already within the app. It's very confusing for the user.

#dogfooding
FAIL_TO_PASS: ["mobile-app - should identify the Android mobile app", "mobile-app - should identify the iOS mobile app", "mobile-app - should not identify an unknown user agent"]
